subject: info-ds
title: (R)INFO.DS.------AFL.
description: Chart on book p. 420 (MID-W-14). INFO-DS (information dissemination) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; AFL (affinity alignment) is the partner. From the subject: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions, with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion"), INFO-DY and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From APP-RDEF: POL-P (political policies). From INFO-DY: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). From PHY-U-P: POL-DY (political dynamics). From PROG-CONT: PART (participation, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of") and RT-DY (reality dynamics). From RT-DY: INTR (interpretation, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of") and OP-SD (option spread). From OP-SD: INFO-TRNS (information transference).
